questions.prompt: Which country was led by Kwame Nkrumah at independence?
questions.fact: It was the first sub-Saharan African colony to gain independence, in 1957.

questions.prompt: Which system in the body produces and stores bile, blood cells and hormones?
options: No single system does all three
questions.fact: Bile comes from the liver, blood cells from marrow, and hormones from several glands across different systems.

questions.prompt: Which sport features a position called the sweeper?
questions.fact: In football it describes a defender behind the line; in curling it describes the player brushing the ice.

questions.prompt: Which film features a character called Katniss's sister Prim?
questions.fact: The volunteering scene that opens the story was filmed in a real North Carolina town square.

questions.prompt: Which country contains the Serengeti's northern extension, the Masai Mara?
questions.fact: The wildebeest migration crosses the border between the two reserves twice a year.

questions.prompt: Which term describes a humorous play with an improbable plot?
questions.fact: Its structures rely on doors, mistaken identity and precise timing, which is why they are so hard to stage.

questions.prompt: Which company created the Postman API testing tool?
questions.fact: It began as a free browser extension built by a developer frustrated with testing APIs by hand.
